body: I support colour intensity (hdr), but we want to consult the rendering team and reduz since they vetoed the change during the colour picker rework.

Tested locally, I noticed some issues:

- Switching to RAW mode increases the dialog's height, which can cause the bottom of the dialog to be unreachable if it spawns at the bottom of a window:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/84e545a0-d7a1-4269-bcb2-b28e3d57ad0b

- The icon when the color is overbright doesn't display correctly in the running project:

![Screenshot_20241119_194447](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/65684f06-7a3e-4087-bacf-16fac25e2cc7)

In contrast, it displays correctly in the editor:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5ec88c45-8392-4295-b1f6-07fb973d9f74)

- Switching to the OKHSL Circle picker will result in broken rendering if you were in the RAW mode and intensity is over 1 (this isn't a new issue IIRC, but it's easier to achieve now):

![Screenshot_20241119_194624](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5fb06a00-d7cf-49f6-a7f6-226cb2a0a179)
